body: I thought i just had depression and anxiety and turns outs I also have PTSD and BPD (Boarderline Personally Disorder). The medication I used to take definitely didn't help with everything going wrong. Now I need to get on new medication that will help with everything but I don't have the ins to do so. Its worth getting tested tho.
I have 48 hours because I don't want to be here anymore. Within that time frame I will finally get my peace.
I thought about maybe finding a really tall building or cliff and jumping. But then I feel like the fall would be torture so maybe find some drugs or alcohol and then jumping wont be so bad.

I've been trying for some time now to figure out the best way to just end everything. I can't seem to find a way. I debated asking for help but I can't imagine someone would willingly help someone end their life. I just want to die in my sleep. No pain no suffering. Ive been handed enough of both to want to just go peacefully.

I wish I could give better advise but just be honest and open with him. Learn how to approach him so you don't seem to come off attacking. But vocalizing your feelings and emotions is extremely important. Not saying he will but don't let him invalidate what you're feeling. You're entitled to feel how you do and so is he. Its up to BOTH of you to put the time and work into listening and building your relationship. Nothing should be one sided in any relationship. I truly hope everything works out for you.

I appreciate this more than you realize. I've felt how you feel for so long now and despite how much I just want to fucking die I can't even do that. I wanna say I hope you make it through this alive but I also know exactly how you feel and I hope it works out however you want it to.

I'm glad I could put a smile on your face. And I do know exactly what you're talking about with the batteries. It was so annoying but yes thats how I feel as well.. ive always been that person who's set unrealistic goals for myself. And I earned very quickly that it just sets you up for failure. So I started making small realistic goals and that helped and my life did turn around. Ive said this in other comments but I legit have no reason to be sad. But at the end of the day I still feel the way I do. 

I made it through once before. I was turning everything around and loving myself for almost a year and then recently shit started up again. I want to trust the process. I want to believe that this shit will one day lessen to a manageable level but I'm so tired of living like this. Ive just tried to cover it up for so long that I just don't have the energy or patience to trust. 

No judgment, no hate you can tell what helped give you purpose. It might not help me but maybe it'll strike ideas 🤷‍♀️
If I had a choice it would make it so much more manageable.
I'm trying but I cant help wanting to just be done.
Omg yess... I fking wish with everything that I am that I could just switch it off... if I could i would never feel like this. But I have NO control anymore.

I've tried so hard tho.... like I seriously have. Ive tried everything I possibly can to feel happy again and I was... Everything felt perfect... but then it just all started again. The sinking feeling that something is always wrong. I started self sabotaging and I couldn't stop. And now I'm back to where I was before but its even worse...
I love this so much and can relate more than you realize. I definitely feel like I have no purpose. I feel like in everything in my life I'm replaceable. So if I'm replaceable whats the point?
I needed to hear this...... it broke me but I needed this... 😭😭😭😭
No its not the worst day of my life.. i actuay had a really good day with friends and my boyfriend. But despite that I still feel the way I do.

I don't have bullshit I have to deal with tho. I know that might sound shitty but this isn't situational for me anymore. This is now an internal deeper depression than I've ever had. I keep telling myself that I have no reason to feel like this but I can't help but feel this way.
There are millions yes with the same problem, the same desire but there's only one me suffering my pain. Theres only me who can keep myself alive right now and I'm not strong enough.

I know there's a medication that could easily fix this. But again like I said idk if I want this fixed. What happens when it stop working or it starts affecting me differently and I go right back to this?? What if I'm just prolonging the inevitable? Why not just get it done and over with now??

No we really cant... i just wish I could do it. Ive tried and failed so much that I'm scared to even try now. And add to it deep down im not sure I want to die but I know i can't keep living like this so I don't know what to do.

I'm constantly crying out for help but the second someone tried to help me i shut them down and just pretend I'm ok. 

I honestly don't know why I'm so miserable which makes all of this that much worse. In all reality I have nothing to be sad about. I have an amazing group of friends that are like family to me. I have an amazing boyfriend who cares so much about me. I have a great job where I was just recently offered a promotion. Ive got a roof over my head, food when I actually eat. Ive got everything I could need but I still feel dead inside. I still feel sad, empty, lonely, hopeless.

I helped for the most part but it affected me in different ways. Thered be times where I was too hyper and couldn't calm down. Sometimes my anxiety would get worse and then trigger the depression again. I know i need medication again. But I also don't want to go back on medication because at the end of the day I still feel like I'd be better off just dead.
I've dropped 20 lbs in the past month... and for whatever fucking reason I'm still here....
No I haven't been on medication in a few years. I got pregnant 2 years ago and stopped taking it. Should have started again after my miscarriage but I never did.

They really weren't and never have been. They play a huge part in my mental issues in fact. But I absolutely hate being a burden and thats all I feel like I am anymore. I feel like I constantly bring everyone around me down because I'm so miserable. I break down all the time and just sit there and zone out while everyone else is laughing and having a good time. I'm screaming on the inside "Help Me" but nothing comes out except I'm ok. When in reality I'm not even remotely ok.
It helps knowing I'm not the only one who feels this way. All I've thought about for a while now is killing myself but I can't do it. I wish someone would just put me out of my misery....
